sources.quote: Unfolded: 345.7 x 276.2 x 8.6 mm (13.61 x 10.87 x 0.34 inches)
X1 Fold 16: starting at 1.26 kg (2.78 lbs)
1x USB-C 3.2 Gen 2 ... 2x Thunderbolt 4 / USB4 40Gbps ... 1x Nano-SIM card slot
Case Material Aluminium + 100% recycled woven performance fabric
Over two hundred parts move synchronously within the hinge design

notes: ONE PANEL THAT FOLDS - single display, role primary. AXIS MAPPING: Lenovo publishes BOTH states as (WxDxH). Folded 176.2 x 276.2 x 17.4 mm -> closed.width 176.2, closed.height 276.2, closed.depth 17.4. Unfolded 345.7 x 276.2 x 8.6 mm -> open.width 345.7, open.height 276.2, open.depth 8.6. Manufacturer WIDTH -> width, manufacturer DEPTH -> height, manufacturer HEIGHT/thickness -> depth throughout. Here the fold runs along the 276.2 mm edge, so height is constant between states and width halves (345.7 -> 176.2) while thickness roughly doubles (8.6 -> 17.4) - internally consistent, and this is also the evidence for hinge.axis. FOLDED USABLE DIAGONAL: PSREF states the panel is '16.3" when open and 12" when folded'; the 12in figure is the usable half in laptop posture, recorded only here, not as a second display object. mass_g 1260 = 'starting at 1.26 kg' x 1000 for the WLAN / 48Wh configuration, the lightest of three PSREF weight rows; the others are 1.311 kg (WLAN 64Wh) and 1.314 kg (WWAN 64Wh), and the detachable ThinkPad Bluetooth TrackPoint Keyboard and Stand adds around 627 g for a ~1.887 kg total. SOURCE DISCREPANCY: the 2022-09-01 Lenovo press release quotes folded '176.4 x 276.2 x 17.4mm' and system weight '1.28kg', against PSREF's 176.2 mm and 1.26 kg; PSREF (the model-specific spec database, doc dated January 22 2024) is preferred and the press-release variance is recorded here rather than averaged. The press release also writes the panel as 2024x2560 (portrait order) where PSREF writes 2560x2024. ASPECT CAVEAT: PSREF states aspect '4:3' but 2560/2024 = 1.265, which is NOT 4:3; active_area_mm was therefore derived from the sourced diagonal + sourced resolution assuming SQUARE PIXELS, not from the stated 4:3 - w = 16.3 x 2560 / sqrt(2560^2+2024^2) x 25.4 = 324.8 mm, h = 16.3 x 2024 / sqrt(2560^2+2024^2) x 25.4 = 256.8 mm. Using the marketing 4:3 instead would give 331.2 x 248.4 mm, so the two methods disagree by ~6 mm and the stated aspect should be treated as rounded. refresh_hz null - PSREF's display table has no refresh-rate column for this model. max_angle_deg and free_stop null - Lenovo describes a 'bell-shaped system hinge' that folds flat but publishes no angle or free-stop rating. PORTS: 3x USB-C total (2x Thunderbolt 4 + 1x USB-C 3.2 Gen 2), all recorded as usb_c; the nano-SIM slot is OPTIONAL, present only on WWAN models. Positions null. materials.cover_glass null. released null - the press release says only 'Q4' 2022.
